job_spec.structural_change: qkd_ectl as THREE DIE LEAVES with their own clock roots (A 254.88 | B 254.88 | C 138.24 x 129.6 um) in place of the one 648-um tile (qkd_ectl_slot-q13r3: 14,806 sinks on one root, TritonCTS insertion 357..538 ps / spread 181, declared spine 616..654 ps, CTS hold repair stalled on 8,710 endpoints): the row FIFO is sliced by word bits (2 SRAMs in A, 2 in B), the e FIFO's SRAM level is 128 x 64 registers in C (no macro in the 138-um leaf), every leaf carries a copy of the control and a control-only copy of the FIFOs it does not hold, so no timing loop crosses a seam; every die input reaches each control copy three flops after its pin (start / exp_done / nb_cr +2 cycles, q beat +1, row response +1); S / E are strap pins
